subject: Vendr profile consolidation & lightweight evidence roadmap
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@clearforge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr profile consolidation & lightweight evidence roadmap

Hi Liam —

Thanks for taking the time earlier. Per our quick sync, we want to minimize friction for your security team while getting the minimum required evidence into Vendr so your procurement checklist is green. I attached a one-sheet (vendr-onboard-map_v1.xlsx) that maps the typical SIG/CAIQ sections we need to the smallest acceptable artifacts.

Quick asks to help us scope the work:
- Confirm you prefer Vendr for profile hosting (vs. Whistic/OneTrust).
- Any SSO or IP restrictions for service accounts (we can use short-lived uploads).
- Which SOC 2 scope (type II, infra-only, product) you want us to map first.

If Vendr is good, Camila will own the upload choreography and Jonas will provision a temporary service account for the window. Proposed initial window: next Tue (8/10) for a 48-hour ingest.

Thanks — I kept the plan intentionally light so we can move quickly.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

Attachments: vendr-onboard-map_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@clearforge.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearforge.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr profile consolidation & lightweight evidence roadmap

Sean —

Vendr works well for us; we've used it with a couple of vendors. A few quick notes from our security team:
- We need the uploader to support SAML-based service accounts; if not, short-lived presigned uploads are fine.
- We'll scope SOC 2 Type II (product + infra) for the initial exchange.
- Preferred ingest window: 2026-08-10 through 2026-08-11.

I've attached an initial SIG extract to speed the mapping — you'll see which controls are already covered internally. If you can provide the Vendr field names we should populate, that will help our team avoid back-and-forth.

Liam
Liam O'Neal
Director, IT Risk & Compliance, ClearForge Inc.
liam.oneal@clearforge.com

Attachments: clearforge-sig-extract.pdf (document stub)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@clearforge.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr profile consolidation & lightweight evidence roadmap

Thanks Liam — that window works.

Plan (lightweight MAP / mutual action plan):
1) Preflight (due 8/07) — Sean: finalize the Vendr field->SIG mapping (attached).
2) Provisioning (due 8/08) — Jonas: create a short-lived service account or presign approach for ClearForge uploads, scope: 48h window.
3) Ingest (8/10–8/11) — Camila: live upload support and QA; we'll validate field mappings and tag the SOC 2 artifacts.
4) Post-validate (by 8/13) — Sean/Camila: confirm profile complete and share the Vendr link with Liam/security.

A few implementation notes:
- We'll prioritize evidence that satisfies the mapped SIG control set for SOC 2 Type II (product + infra).
- If ClearForge prefers to upload a consolidated zip, we can unpack and attach artifacts to the corresponding Vendr fields.

—Sean
